reason: Repair card copy that restates the label printed beside it -- 'Best scene: The best scene is ...', 'Known For: The Suture Circus is known for ...'. dream_prose_quality now detects this class (LABEL_ECHOES); 20 of 34 built bundles are affected across known_for, local_rule, best_scene and best_used_when. Silas, 2026-08-31, after reviewing the repaired digest: 'Do the pass and rewrite.'

before.known_for: The Moonstone Bathhouse is known for a boiler nobody in this century knows how to have built.
before.best_scene: The best scene is the moment the boiler door opens and the light inside is the wrong colour for fire, cold and blue-white against the steam.

after.known_for: Nobody in this century knows how the boiler was built, and the bathhouse runs on it anyway.
after.best_scene: The boiler door swings open and the light inside is the wrong color for fire, cold and blue-white against the steam.

before.known_for: Halewater Spine is known for being a whole village lashed to the back of a living god.
before.local_rule: The local rule is simple and unbending: cut your house loose before the dive, never during.
before.best_scene: The best scene comes when the deck tilts as the god rolls, and every cable in the village sings one note.
before.skill_best_used_when: It is best used when someone younger is still down there and running out of air faster than they can surface.

after.known_for: Every house here stands lashed by cable to the living hide of a sleeping god, a whole village riding one broad grey back.
after.local_rule: Cables come free before the god dives, never while it is diving; timing is the only law that matters on Halewater Spine.
after.best_scene: The deck tilts hard as the god rolls beneath it, and every taut cable in the village rings out the same single note at once.
after.skill_best_used_when: Someone younger is still under the water, air running out faster than they can kick for the surface.

before.known_for: The yard is known for salvaging drone parts out of the fungal wastes before the nightly bloom swallows the route.
before.best_scene: The best scene is when a drone comes home coated in a spore pattern shaped like a face.
before.item_best_used_when: It is best used when you need proof of the bloom without exposing yourself to it.

after.known_for: Salvagers pick drone parts out of the fungal wastes here, racing to beat the nightly bloom before it swallows the route.
after.best_scene: A drone comes home coated in a spore pattern shaped like a face, and for a moment nobody in the yard says a word.
after.item_best_used_when: Study the bloom up close without ever stepping into the spores yourself.

before.known_for: Mercado de la Fortuna is known for dishes that taste like probability itself, cooked to order over bioluminescent water.

after.known_for: Every dish served here tastes like probability itself, ladled to order over the lagoon's bioluminescent glow.

before.known_for: The Regrowth Yards are known for hulls that regrow themselves overnight, knitting fresh pulse-metal flesh over gashes as if the ships refuse to admit they were ever wounded.

after.known_for: Hulls here regrow themselves overnight, knitting fresh pulse-metal flesh over gashes as if the ships refuse to admit they were ever wounded.

before.known_for: The Drowned Overture is known for hosting the last note ever sung, the one that silenced an entire fleet.

after.known_for: The last note ever sung here silenced an entire fleet, and the coral walls have not forgotten its shape.

before.known_for: Halcyon Mirrorfield is known for its ten thousand hand-set mirrors, each one aimed by hand before sunrise to catch and throw the first light.
before.best_scene: The best scene is when all ten thousand beams finally converge and a single fig tree ignites like a struck match.
before.item_best_used_when: It is best used when something must not move again before witnesses arrive.

after.known_for: Ten thousand hand-set mirrors step down the terraced slope, each one aimed by hand before sunrise to catch and throw the first light.
after.best_scene: All ten thousand beams finally converge, and a single fig tree ignites like a struck match.
after.item_best_used_when: Something must not move again before witnesses arrive.

before.known_for: The Ribbed Sound is known for its bay, roofed entirely by the ribs of something still breathing.

after.known_for: A bay entirely roofed by the ribs of something still breathing, its violet-crusted bones arching over the water like a cathedral built from a living thing.

before.known_for: The Roofline Circuit is known for rooftop stages wired straight into the flood barriers, turning every performance into the current that keeps the city's lamps burning.
before.local_rule: The local rule is simple and absolute: the loudest verse gets the power, and silence anywhere on the line invites the flood.
before.item_best_used_when: It is best used when the crowd has gone quiet and the barrier lamps are dimming.
before.skill_best_used_when: It is best used when the cable has gone dark between verses and the lamps need current now.

after.known_for: Rooftop stages here are wired straight into the flood barriers, turning every performance into the current that keeps the city's lamps burning.
after.local_rule: The loudest verse gets the power, and silence anywhere on the line invites the flood.
after.item_best_used_when: A spent voice reaches for the reed when the crowd has gone quiet and the barrier lamps are dimming.
after.skill_best_used_when: The wire calls for it the moment the cable goes dark between verses and the lamps demand current now.

before.known_for: Sixmile Camp is known for serving the one hot meal that stands between the ore face and the long walk down the valley road.
before.item_best_used_when: It is best used when people are too tired to keep arguing on empty stomachs.
before.skill_best_used_when: It is best used when there is not enough and everyone knows it.

after.known_for: The one hot meal served here stands between the ore face and the long walk down the valley road.
after.item_best_used_when: Hungry, exhausted people stop arguing and sit down together once this comes out.
after.skill_best_used_when: When there isn't enough to go around and everyone in line can count, this keeps the peace.

before.known_for: The Ninth Deck Floodline is known for a flooded cargo level nobody has yet filmed all the way across.

after.known_for: A flooded cargo level stretches out of camera range, and nobody who has tried to film its far end has ever brought back footage of arriving there.

before.known_for: The Suture Circus is known for pitching its tents directly over active fault lines and performing in the gaps between tremors.
before.best_scene: The best scene is the big top's canvas rippling in sync with a distant quake while the crowd holds its breath.

after.known_for: Its tents rise directly over active fault lines, timing every act to the gaps between tremors.
after.best_scene: The canvas ripples in sync with a distant quake as the crowd holds its collective breath.

before.known_for: It is known for its corridor of black-boned trees, so dense that no survey from orbit can see through it.
before.local_rule: The local rule is simple: the border is wherever it was last walked, not wherever it was last drawn.
before.best_scene: The best scene is when a company skiff crosses the corridor and the trees close in silently behind it.

after.known_for: A corridor of black-boned trees grows so dense here that no orbital survey can see through it.
after.local_rule: The border exists wherever it was last walked, not wherever it was last drawn on a map.
after.best_scene: A company skiff crosses the corridor and the trees close in silently behind it, erasing the way it came.

before.known_for: Kelphold Rig is known for harvesting a kelp canopy that nobody is allowed to go under alone, except on the deep shift.
before.local_rule: The rule is simple: come up when the lamps go amber, whatever you are holding.

after.known_for: A kelp canopy so dense nobody goes under it alone, except whoever draws the deep shift.
after.local_rule: When the lamps go amber, you come up immediately, whatever you are holding.

before.known_for: Sump Nine is known for bog that exists only where the herd has walked this season.

after.known_for: The bog here exists only in the herd's footprints, a season's worth of water written into the ground one hoofstep at a time.

before.known_for: This domed greenhouse is known for breeding orchid mantises as living security, camouflaged among cactus grafts fed on brimstone runoff.
before.best_scene: The best scene is a duel fought down a narrow aisle of grafted cacti while unseen mantises shift color along the stems, tracking the blades.

after.known_for: This domed greenhouse breeds orchid mantises as living security, their bodies camouflaged among cactus grafts fed on brimstone runoff.
after.best_scene: A duel unfolds down a narrow aisle of grafted cacti while unseen mantises shift color along the stems, tracking every blade.

before.known_for: The Ironback Hulk is known for the gutted carcass of a kilometre-long terraforming leviathan, still sealed at its core.

after.known_for: The gutted carcass of a kilometre-long terraforming leviathan lies here, its core still sealed after all this time.

before.known_for: The Living Auditorium is known for sets that molt into other eras in the middle of a scene.

after.known_for: Its sets molt into other eras in the middle of a scene, leaving actors stranded mid-line in a century that did not exist a moment before.

before.known_for: The Petitioner's Larder is known for ingredients that must be won over, not merely harvested, before they can be plated.

after.known_for: Every ingredient stored here must be persuaded to give itself up, since none of them will simply hold still for the knife.

before.known_for: The Halo Stage is known for duets sung as the herd crosses overhead, after which both singers wake with matching seams of warm gold beneath the skin.

after.known_for: Singers duet here as the herd crosses overhead, and those it favors wake with matching seams of warm gold beneath the skin.
